research_integrity: Explicit algebraic derivation, finite verification, and comparisons with accessible primary literature; no claim of independent validation or historical absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: The family is restricted to smooth parameters; the degenerations at lambda=0,1 are excluded.
Only geometric p-rank and a-number are determined: p-rank zero is not asserted to imply supersingularity.
Exceptional parameter counts are marked coefficient counts, not counts of geometric isomorphism classes.
The possible existence of unindexed prior equivalent calculations remains a historical priority risk.
title: The nonordinary divisor of a cyclic-quintic genus-four hyperelliptic family in characteristics \(3\) and \(7\)
